7:88: Nnan d imḍebbṛen imzuxiyen, n ugdud is,: "a k nessuffeɣ a Cuɛayeb, kečč, akked wid iumnen yidek, si temdint nneɣ, neɣ a d tuɣaleḍ ar ddin nneɣ". Inna: "xas nugi?
7:89: Ihi, nger ed tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, ma nuɣal ar ddin nnwen, mbaɛd ma Isellek aɣ Ṛebbi, segs. Ur aɣ ilaq ara a nuɣal ɣuṛes, siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi, Mass nneɣ. Mass nneɣ Issemḥalleq i yal cci s tmusni. Neţkel ɣef Ṛebbi". A Mass nneɣ! Fru ţ garaneɣ akked ugdud nneɣ, s tideţ. Kečč Tifeḍ akw wid iferrun.
7:90: Nnan imḍebbṛen, wid ijehlen, n ugdud is: "ma teddam d Cuɛayeb, war ccekk a ţxesṛem."
7:91: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeţţat.
7:92: Wid iskaddben Cuɛayeb, uɣalen amzun ur zdiɣen. Wid iskaddben Cuɛayeb, d nitni ay d imexṣuṛen.
7:93: Iwexxeṛ asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Niɣ ssawḍeɣ awen d tibṛatin n Mass iw, neṣḥeɣ kwen. Amek ara ɣwebleɣ ɣef ugdud ijehliyen"?
7:94: Ur Nuzen ara nnbi ar temdint, mebla ma Newwet imezdaɣ is s cedda, akked lemḍeṛṛa, amar ad ḥiwten.
7:95: Sinna, Nerra iseɣ deg umkan n tucmiţ, armi wexxṛen, nnan: "niɣ jeṛṛben imezwura nneɣ lemḍeṛṛa akked ttrika". Newwet iten deqzalla, nitni ur bnin.
7:96: Lemmer kan uminen u ḥezzben imezdaɣ n temdinin, war ccekk, ad asen Nelli lbaṛakat seg igenni akked tmurt. Maca, skaddben. Nessemḥalleq asen, ilmend n wayen keţţben.
7:97: Day ɣilen imezdaɣ n temdinin, ur ten id teţţaweḍ tiyta nneɣ, deg yiḍ, nitni ṭṭsen?
7:98: Neɣ day ɣilen imezdaɣ n temdinin, ur ten id teţţaweḍ tiyta nneɣ, deg wazal, nitni ţţuraren?
7:99: Day ɣilen sellken i tandit n Ṛebbi? Siwa agdud i ixesṛen, i iɣilen sellken i tandit n Ṛebbi.
7:100: Neɣ day ur d Iban ara, i wid ara iweṛten tamurt, deffir imezdaɣ is, ar, ma ihwa yaɣ, a ten Newwet ɣef ibekkaḍen nnsen, a Nesleɣ ulawen nnsen, dɣa nitni ur sellen?
7:101: D timdinin agi, iɣef ak Nḥekku, si teqṣiḍin nnsent. Niɣ usan ɣuṛsent imazanen nnsent, s ubeggen. Ur llint d tid ara iamnen deg wayen skaddbent uqbel. Akka i Iselleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen ijehliyen.
7:102: Ur Nufi nnesba ar tegwti nnsen. Nufa, tegwti nnsen, d iballaɣen.
7:103: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nneɣ, ar Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Densen ten. Wali amek teḍṛa d ifessaden.
7:104: Inna Musa: "a Ferɛun! Nek d amazan sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
7:105: D ṣṣeḥ, ur qqaṛeɣ, ɣef Ṛebbi, siwa tideţ. Ih, usiɣ kwen id, s ubeggen n Mass nnwen. Ihi, azen yidi At Isṛail".
7:106: Inna: "ma tusiḍ d s ussekni, zzi t id, ma tessawalaḍ tideţ".
7:107: Iḍeggeṛ taɛkwazt is, aţţan d azrem n ṣṣeḥ.
7:108: Issuffeɣ ed afus is, iban ed d amellal i imnezhen.
7:109: Nnan d imḍebbṛen n ugdud n Ferɛun: "wagi, s tideţ, d aseḥḥar amusnaw".
7:110: "Ibɣa a kwen issuffeɣ si tmurt nnwen, d acu t lameṛ nnwen"?
7:111: Nnan: "anef as, neţţa akked gma s. Azen iberraḥen ar temdinin,
7:112: ad ak d awin yal aseḥḥar amusnaw".
7:113: Usan d iseḥḥaren n Ferɛun, nnan: "s tideţ, ad aɣ tkafiḍ, ma d nekwni ara iɣelben"?
7:114: Inna: "ih, u, s tideţ, a ţţilim d iqṛiben".
7:115: Nnan: "a Musa! A ţḍeggṛeḍ kečč, neɣ a nḍeggeṛ nekwni"?
7:116: Inna: "ḍeggṛet"! Mi ḍeggṛen, sdehcen allen n lɣaci, ssagwden ten. Bbwin d ssḥur anect ilat.
7:117: Nweḥḥa i Musa: "ḍeggeṛ taɛkwazt ik"! Aţan tesseblaɛ ayen d ṣenɛan.
7:119: Akka ay ţwaɣelben. Uɣalen ar deffir, d unqisen.
7:123: Inna Ferɛun: "day tumnem yis, uqbel ma ɛammdeɣ awen? Ayagi, war ccekk, d tifxeţ. Tundim ţ di temdint, iwakken a ţţessuffɣem, segs, imezdaɣ is. Ihi, deqqal a ţţeẓṛem.
7:124: War ccekk, ad awen gezmeɣ afus ssya, aḍaṛ ssya. Sinna, ih, a kwen semmṛeɣ akw ɣef imudag".
7:126: Terriḍ d ţţaṛ segneɣ, imi kan numen s issekniyen n Mass nneɣ, mi ɣ d usan. A Mass nneɣ! Azen aɣ d ṣṣbeṛ, Ddem leṛwaḥ nneɣ d imḍuɛen".
7:127: Imḍebbṛen n ugdud n Ferɛun, nnan: "day a ţţeooeḍ Musa akked ugdud is, ad ssefsaden di tmurt, a kwen ooen, kečč akked iṛebbiten ik"? Inna: "a neneɣ arrac nnsen, a nessider tilawin nnsen. Nekwni, sennig sen, d iqehhaṛen".
7:128: Inna Musa i ugdud is: "ţţret afus n Ṛebbi, u ṣebṛet. Tamurt, war ccekk, n Ṛebbi. A ţ iwṛet win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Taggara i wid iţḥezziben".
7:129: Nnan: "njaf uqbel a ɣ d taseḍ, u deffir tisin ik". Inna: "amar Mass nnwen ad Ineɣ acengu nnwen, a kwen Irr d igensas di tmurt, ad Iwali amek ara txedmem".
7:130: Newwet, dɣa, lois n Ferɛun s iseggwasen n llaẓ, akked nneqs n ţţemṛa, amar a d mmektin.
7:131: Ma iusa ten id iseɣ, ad inin: "nneɣ wagi". Ma tusa ten id tucmiţ, a ţ sbibben i Musa akked wid illan yides. Ayen iḍeṛṛun yidsen, day mačči ar Ṛebbi kan? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
7:132: Nnan: " wicqa assekni ara d tawiḍ, ur aɣ teţseḥḥireḍ yis. Nekwni, ur neţţamen yisek".
7:133: Nuzen asen aḥemmal, ajṛad, tilkin, imqweṛqwṛen, idammen, d issekniyen ifeṣlen. Smeɣwṛen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
7:134: Mi teḍṛa yidsen twaɣit, qqaṛen: "a Musa! Nɛaṛ Mass ik i nekwni, s wayen i k Iɛahed. Ma tekkseḍ aɣ tawaɣit, a namen yisek, a nazen yidek At Isṛail".
7:135: Mi sen Nekkes tawaɣit, ar lajel iten iggunin, atnan nitni xedɛan.
7:136: Nerra d segsen ţţaṛ, Nɣemq iten deg ill, imi skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, ur d celɛen degsen.
7:137: Nessewṛet i ugdud i illan qehṛen t, igmaḍ akked ituram n tmurt, i Neṛqa. Itam wawal ṣṣam n Mass ik, ɣef At Isṛail, ilmend n wayen ṣebṛen. Nhudd ayen iṣennaɛ Ferɛun akked ugdud is, u wayen bennun.
7:138: Nesɛadda ill i At Isṛail. Mmugren d agdud i iɛabden tiɛancuṛin is. Nnan: "a Musa! Err aneɣ ṛebbi am iṛebbiten nnsen". Inna: "kunwi, s tideţ, d agdud ur nessin.
7:139: Wigi, s tideţ, ad inger wayen ideg llan, ad inqeḍ wayen xeddmen".
7:140: Inna: "day awen buddeɣ ṛebbi, war Ṛebbi, u Neţţa Ismenyaf ikwen ɣef imaḍalen"?
7:141: Mi kwen Nsellek si lois n Ferɛun, sukken fellawen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ maḍi; neqqen arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, ajeṛṛeb sɣuṛ Mass nnwen ameqwṛaḥan.
7:142: Nemlal akked Musa kraḍet waḍan, Nerna yasen mraw. Tebbweḍ tallit n Mass is, kuzet waḍan. Inna Musa i gma s Haṛun: "enṣef iyi ar ugdud iw, exdem ayen ilhan, ur teddu d ubrid ifessaden".
7:143: Mi d iusa Musa ar temlilit nneɣ, u Immeslay as Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ssenɛat iyi d, a K waliɣ". Inna d: "ur iyI teţwaliḍ, d awezɣi, maca muqel s adrar. Ma iqqim deg umekkan is, ad iyI twaliḍ". Mi d Iusa Mass is s adrar, Irra t d saḥel. Iɣli Musa, ixsef. Mi d iuki, inna: "gedha s yiseK! Utubeɣ K, nek d amezwaru n lmumnin".
7:144: Inna: "a Musa! Aql I Smenyafeɣ k ɣef imdanen, i tebṛatin iW, i wawal iW. Ddem ayen i k d Fkiɣ, ili seg wid isnemmiren".
7:145: Nura yas, di tlewḥin, si yal cci, anabi akked ufeṣṣel n yal cci. Ddem itent s tezmert, ameṛ i ugdud ik a tent iṭṭef s lmaɛna nnsent. Ad awen Ssekneɣ tanezduɣt iballaɣen.
7:146: Ad Veṛṛfeɣ, seg issekniyen iW, wid ismeɣwṛen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. Mi walan yal assekni, ur ţţamnen yis. Ma walan abrid uṣwib, ur teddun degs. Ma walan abrid n leɣwlaḍ, a t awin. Ayagi, acku, s tideţ, skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, ur d celɛen degsen.
7:147: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, akked temlilit n laxeṛt, ur swin igiten nnsen. Day a ten kafin ɣef wayen ur nelli d ayen xeddmen?
7:148: Agdud n Musa, deffir es, isbedd, s ṛṛḥuḥ is, aɛjmi bu loeţţa isrugmuten. Day ur walan ara ar, s tideţ, ur asen d iţmeslay, ur la ten inehhu s abrid? Ɛabden t, llan d imednas.
7:149: Mi ţţuḥeccmen, u walan ar, ziɣ nnetlafen, nnan: "ma ur Iḥun ara fellaɣ Mass nneɣ, ma ur aɣ Isemmeḥ ara, war ccekk, a nuɣal seg imexsuṛen".
7:150: Mi d iuɣal Musa ar ugdud is, s wurrif akked lḥemṣa, inna: "ay d ucmit wayen is iyi tneṣfem, deffir iw! Tebɣam a d iɣiwwel lameṛ n Mass nnwen"? Iḍeggeṛ tilewḥin, iṭṭef gma s seg uqeṛṛu, ijebt it id ɣuṛes. Inna d: "a mmi s n yimma, s tideţ, iḥqeṛ iyi ugdud, qṛib iyi nɣan. Ur ssefṛaḥ icenga yissi. Ur iyi ţţarra seg ugdud imednas".
7:151: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeḥ aneɣ, nek akked gma, Ssekcem aɣ ar uḥunu K. Kečč, Tifeḍ akw wid iţḥunun".
7:152: Ih, wid iɛabden aɛajmi, a d iɣli fellasen wurrif n Mass nnsen, ad ndellen di tmeddurt n ddunit. Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi wid id isnulfuyen.
7:153: Wid ixedmen tucmitin, sinna, steṛoɛen deffir sent, u umnen, Mass ik, s tideţ, deffir sent, ar Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
7:154: Mi irs wurrif is, iddem ed Musa tilewḥin. Di tira nnsent, nnhaya akked uḥunu i wid iţţagwaden Mass nnsen.
7:155: Ifren ed Musa ṣatet irgazen seg ugdud is, ad mlilen yidneɣ. Mi ten tewwet zzenzla, inna: "a Mass iw! Lemmer i K ihwi, yili, iuɣ lḥal, Tenɣiḍ ten, u Tegliḍ yissi. Day ad aɣ Temḥuḍ, ilmend n wayen xedmen ijeɣlufen segneɣ? Wagi d ahewwel iK kan, Tettellifeḍ syis win i K ihwan, Tnehhuḍ win i K ihwan. Kečč d Bab nneɣ, Semmeḥ aɣ, Ḥun fellaɣ, Kečč Tifeḍ akw wid iţsemmiḥen.
7:156: Aru yaɣ iseɣ di ddunit, di laxeṛt; aql aɣ nuɣal ed ɣuṛeK". Inna d: "aɛaqeb iW, a t Sɛaddiɣ ɣef win iyI ihwan. Aḥunu W ijemmel yal cci. A t Aruɣ i wid iţḥezziben, iţzekkin, akked wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ,
7:157: wid iteddun d Umazan, Nnbi ur neɣṛi, i ufan iura ɣuṛsen di Tuṛa akked Linoil". Iumeṛ asen d lqanun, Itekkes asen ayen n dir. Iḥell asen lɛali, igdel asen dduni. Ikkes asen aruz akked lqid nnsen. Ihi, wid iumnen yis, i t iɛawnen, i t isellken, iddan d tafat id irsen yides, widak d imerbaḥ.
7:158: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek d Amazan n Ṛebbi ɣuṛwen meṛṛa. Neţţa, ineS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Issidir, Ineqq". Ihi, amnet s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, Nnbi ur neɣṛi, i iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wawal iS. Ddut yides, amar a ţţeţwanhum.
7:159: Deg ugdud n Musa, arbaɛ iteddu s tideţ. U syis ay ţḥuddun.
7:160: Nessemfaṛaq iten ɣef mrawsin laɛṛac, n leoyus. Mi s issuter ugdud is tissit, Nweḥḥa i Musa: ewwet aẓṛu s tɛakwaz ik. Fɣent ed segs mrawsnat tliwa; akka, yal amdan iẓṛa anda ara issew. Nesbur iten s usigna, Nessers asen d lmenna akked ifeṛṛuoen: "eččet seg wayen ilhan, is ikwen Nɣat". Ur aɣ dnisen, maca la ddennisen iman nnsen.
7:161: Mi ţwanecden: "zedɣet di temdint agi, eččet segs, ayen i wen ihwan, init: "laɛfu"! Ɛaddit di tebburt, s lekni. Ad awen Nsemmeḥ tuccḍa nnwen. A Nernu i lɛuṣam".
7:162: Wid idensen segsen, neṣfen awalen s wid ur nelli d wid i sen nnan. Nuzen asen tiyta seg igenni, ilmend n wayen ddennisen.
7:163: Steqsi ten ɣef temdint i illan ɣef rrif n yill, mi ur d rzin di ssebt, mi ten id usan iselman nnsen, walan ten, ass n ssebt. Ass, war ssebt, ur ten id ţţasen. Akka ay ten Njeṛṛeb, deg wayen ssexsaṛen.
7:164: Mi d inna lois, segsen: "iwumi la teţnabim agdud ara Isqucc Ṛebbi, neɣ ara Iɛaqeb s leqseḥ"? Nnan: "d asteɣfeṛ ar Mass nnwen, amar ad ḥezzben".
7:165: Mi ţţun ayen iɣef ţwafekkṛen, Nsellek wid itekksen ayen n dir, Nesɛadda aɛaqeb adiran ɣef imednas, ilmend n wayen ssexsaṛen.
7:166: Mi smeɣwṛen iman nnsen ɣef wayen i sen iţwakksen, Nenna yasen: "ilit d uddawen ucmiten"!
7:167: Mi Ixebbeṛ Mass ik, ard asen d Iazen ara ten iɛaqben, s ẓẓuṛ, alamma d ass n tnekra. Mass ik, s tideţ, Iţɣawal ar uɛaqeb. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
7:168: Nessemfaṛaq iten di tmurt, d leoyus, garasen wid imaɛnen, garasen wid ur nemɛin. Njeṛṛeb iten s iseɣiyen akked tucmitin, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
7:169: Neṣfen ten, deffir sen, ineṣṣafen i iweṛten Tazmamt. Pţaddamen lerbaḥ n ddunit, qqaṛen: "ad aɣ semmḥen". Ma rnan usan ten id lerbaḥ, am widen, a ten ddmen. Day ur ɛahden ara s Tezmamt, ard tideţ kan, ara inin ɣef Ṛebbi? U lemden i illan degs. Pţif axxam aneggaru, i wid iţḥezziben. Day ur tfehmem ara?
7:170: Wid iṭṭfen di Tezmamt, iţẓallan, s tideţ, ur Nḍeggiɛ arraz n lɛuṣam.
7:171: Mi Nessuli adrar sennig sen, amzun d tili, ɣilen, s tideţ, ara d iɣli fellasen. Ṭṭfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, smektit ed ayen illan degs, amar a ţḥezzbem.
7:172: Mi d Iddem Mass ik, si tgeẓẓal n tarwa n Adem, dderya nnsen, Inna yasen a d cehhden ɣef yiman nnsen: "day ur Lliɣ ara d Mass nnwen"? Nnan: "ih, ncehhed". Akka ur d teqqaṛem ara, ass n tnekra: "s tideţ, ayagi d ayen ur neẓṛi".
7:173: Neɣ a d tinim: "d imezwura nneɣ kan i icurken, zik. Nekwni d tarwa deffir sen. Day aɣ Tenɣeḍ, ilmend n wayen xedmen wid iṛejjnen"?
7:174: Akka ay Nfeṣṣel issekniyen, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
7:175: Eḥku yasen d tadyant n win iwumi Nefka issekniyen nneɣ. Irra ten akin. Idda yides Cciṭan, iuɣal seg wid iɣeṛqen.
7:176: Lemmer i ɣ ihwi, Nessuli t yissen. Maca, ibɣa tamurt, idda d lhawiyya s. Ihi, amedya s am win n waydi, ma teddiḍ ţ fellas, ad ilehhet, ma teooiḍ t, ad ilehhet. D wagi ay d amedya n ugdud i iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ. Eḥku d tadyant, amar a d mmektin.
7:177: Agdud iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, d yir amedya. Pddennisen iman nnsen.
7:178: Win Inha Ṛebbi, ihi, idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef Ṛebbi, nitni d imexsuṛen.
7:179: Niɣ Neswejd ed, i Loahennama, aṭas n leonun akked yimdanen. Sɛan ulawen, ur fehhmen yissen; sɛan allen, ur ţwalin yissent; sɛan imeẓẓuɣen, ur sellen yissen. Nitni am lmal, neɣ nnetlafen kteṛ. Wigi d iɣwefliyen.
7:180: I Ṛebbi, ismawen ṣṣam. Naɛṛet eP, yissen. Veṛṛfet seg wid issexsaṛen ismawen iS. Ad ţţuqeṭṭin ɣef wayen xeddmen.
7:181: Deg wayen Nexleq, yiwen n lois iḍfeṛ tideţ. Iţḥuddu syis.
7:182: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, a ten Nawi, cwiṭ, cwiṭ, ar wanda ur ẓṛin.
7:183: Ad asen Fkeɣ lmudda. Ih, ticeṛkeţ iW d tunṣiḥt.
7:184: Day ur d teţmeyyizem ara? Ur illi umeddakwel nnwen d aṛehbani. Neţţa, d aneddaṛ kan iţbegginen.
7:185: Day ur walan ara tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen Ixleq Ṛebbi n cci? Niɣ, ahat, iqeṛb ed lajel nnsen. Anwa awal, deffir wagi, ar amnen?
7:186: Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur Isɛi nnahi. A ten Ioo ad hemlen di tjehli nnsen.
7:187: A k steqsayen ɣef yimir, melmi ara d yili. Ini: "i t Iẓṛan siwa Mass iw. D Neţţa kan a t id Isseknen, di lweqt is. Ad iaẓay di tmurt akked igenwan. Ur kwen id iţţaweḍ siwa deqzalla". A k steqsayen amzun tesɛiḍ asali fellas. Ini: "i t Issnen siwa Ṛebbi", maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
7:188: Ini: "ur ksibeɣ i iman iw, abaɣuṛ neɣ ḍḍeṛṛ, kkes ed ayen Irad Ṛebbi. Lemmer ssineɣ tabaḍnit, ad ṛwuɣ lxiṛ, ur iyi iţnal ixmiṛ. Nek d aneddaṛ kan, u d abcir, i ugdud iumnen".
7:189: D Neţţa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiwen n yiman. Iddem ed segs tameṭṭut is, ad izdeɣ yides. Mi insa yides, tebbwi tadist tafessast; telḥa yis. Mi d teṣbeḥ ẓẓayet, naɛṛen Ṛebbi: "a Mass nneɣ! Ma Tefkiḍ aɣ d aɛeṛḍi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
7:190: Mi sen d Ifka aɛeṛdi, rran aS icriken s wayen i sen d Ifka. I aɛlay Ṛebbi, sennig wayen ţcaraken!
7:191: Day ad carken ayen ur nexliq acemma, u d nitni i iţwaxelqen?
7:192: Ur zmiren a ten ɛiwnen, neɣ ad ɛiwnen iman nnsen.
7:193: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur teddun yidwen. Iɛuḍa fellawen ma tnecdem ten, neɣ ma tessusmem.
7:194: S tideţ, wigi tnaɛṛem, war Ṛebbi, d imdanen am kunwi. Naɛret ţen, ma ad awen d rren, maday tessawalem tideţ.
7:195: Day sɛan iḍaṛen, ad lḥun fellasen, neɣ sɛan ifassen, ad ddmen yissen, neɣ sɛan allen, ad walin yisent, neɣ sɛan imeẓẓuɣen, ad slen yissen. Ini: "naɛret icriken nnwen, sinna, andit iyi. Ur iyi sganayet".
7:196: Ih, Bab iw d Ṛebbi id Issersen Tazmamt, i Iḥemmlen lɛuṣam.
7:197: Wid tnaɛṛem, war Neţţa, ur zmiren a kwen ɛawnen, neɣ ad ɛawnen iman nnsen.
7:198: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur sellen. A ten twaliḍ a k id ţmuqulen, nitni ur ţwalin.
7:199: Ddem ayen ilhan, ameṛ ar lewqama, ḍeṛṛef i wid ur nessin.
7:200: Ma ilaɛj ik Cciṭan ar dduni, ţţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
7:201: Ih, wid iţḥezziben, ma innul iten urbaɛ n ccwaṭen, a d mmektin, dɣa ad asen llint wallen.
7:202: Zgan ɣelṭen atmaten nnsen, dɣa nitni ur xeḍḍun.
7:203: Ma ur asen d tebbwiḍ ara assekni, ad ak inin: "acimi ur t id isnulfa ara"? Ini: "tedduɣ kan d wayen iyi d iţţuweḥḥan, sɣuṛ Mass iw". Wagi, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, d tafat, d nnhaya, d aḥunu, i ugdud iumnen.
7:204: Ma qqaṛen Leqwṛan ssemḥesset as, ssusmet, amar fellawen aḥunu.
7:205: Mmekti d Mass ik, deg iman ik, s wannuz akked lxuf, s wawal irsen, taṣebḥit, tameddit. Ur ţţili seg iɣwefliyen.
7:206: Ih, wid illan ar Mass ik, ur smeɣwṛen ara iman nnsen, ɣef uɛbad iS. Sbuccuɛen T, i Neţţa kennun.
8:1: Steqsan k ɣef rrbeḥ. Ini: "rrbeḥ i Ṛebbi akked Umazan. Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, elhut garawen, aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
8:2: Lmumnin d wid kan iwumi iţţergigi wul nnsen, ma Iţwabder ed Ṛebbi. Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen iS, ad innerni liman nnsen. ɣef Mass nnsen, ay ţţeklen.
8:3: Wid ibedden i tẓallit, iţṣeṛṛifen seg wayen is iten Nɣat.
8:4: Wigi d ṣṣeḥ, d lmumnin. I nitni, ar Mass nnsen, tiseddaṛin, ssmaḥ, akked lɣit ukyis.
8:5: Akken ik id Issuffeɣ Mass ik, seg uxxam ik, s tideţ, wanag ur ibɣi urbaɛ si lmumnin.
8:6: La k ţnamaren ɣef tideţ, deffir ubeggen is, amzun kan ţwanehṛen ar tmeţţant, nitni ţḥekkiṛen.
8:7: Mi wen Iɛahed Ṛebbi, ara ţţili nnwen, yiwet si snat n trebbuyaɛ, tessarmem a ţţili nnwen tin ur neţwaselleḥ. Ṛebbi Ibɣa a d itebbet tideţ s wawalen iS, ad ṛẓen wakali ijehliyen.
8:8: A ţţili tideţ, ad inqeḍ lbaṭel, xas ugin ibeɣwḍiyen.
8:9: Mi teţţrem afus sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, Ijaweb awen d: "Nek ad awen Fkeɣ agim lmalayek, mestebɛant".
8:10: Irra t kan Ṛebbi d abecceṛ iwakken ad nneḍmanen yis wulawen nnwen. Ur illi lɣelb, siwa sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
8:11: Mi kwen Iɣumm s yiḍes, d ṭṭmana sɣuṛeS; Isseɣli d fellawen aman seg igenni; a kwen Izzizdeg yissen, ad Issebɛad, fellawen, aɣway n Cciṭan, ad Isseohed ulawen nnwen, ad Itebbet, yissen, isurifen.
8:12: Mi Iweḥḥa Mass ik i lmalayek: "Nek yidkwent; tebbtemt wid iumnen. Ad Skecmeɣ tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen. Ewwtemt sennig tmegraḍ, ewwtemt ar ixfawen iḍudan".
8:13: Ayagi, acku nitni, s tideţ, xuṣmen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. I win ixuṣmen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ihi, Ṛebbi Iwɛaṛ deg uɛaqeb.
8:14: Wagi i kunwi, jeṛṛbet eţ! U i ijehliyen, aɛaqeb n tmes.
8:15: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d wid ijehlen la d ẓeddmen, ur sen reggwlet.
8:16: Win i sen irewlen, assen, siwa ma la issewjad i umennuɣ, neɣ ma ikcem s arbaɛ, winna, a t immager wurrif n Ṛebbi; axxam is d Loahennama, a yir tuɣalin!
8:17: Ur ten tennuɣem, maca d Ṛebbi iten Innuɣen. Ur teṛoimeḍ mi tṛeomeḍ, maca Ṛebbi Iṛoem, iwakken ad Ijeṛṛeb lmumnin s ujeṛṛeb umɛin sɣuṛeS. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
8:19: Tessutrem lɣelb, atan iusa kwen id. Ma tfukkem, ţţif i kunwi. Ma tuɣalem, a Nuɣal. Ula iwumi tent, biţţa, trebbuyaɛ nnwen, xas ṭṭuqtent. Ih, Ṛebbi Idda d lmumnin.
8:20: A wid iumnen! Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur T ţţaooat, u kunwi tsellem.
8:21: Ur ţţilit am wid innan: "nesla", nitni ur sellen.
8:22: ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ineggura imexlaq d iɛeẓẓugen, d igugam, ur nfehhem.
8:23: Lemmer Iẓṛi Ṛebbi degsen lxiṛ, yili Irra ten sellen. Ma Irra ten sellen, war ccekk, ad akwren aḍaṛ, u nitni aɛṣan.
8:24: A wid iumnen! Jawbet i Ṛebbi akked Umazan, ma Inced ikwen ar wayen ikwen issidiren. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iţţili ger umdan akked wul is. ɣuṛeS, Neţţa, s tideţ, ara teţwafessrem.
8:25: Ḥezzbet i uhewwel. Ur iţḥaz ara kan imednas segwen, weḥḥedsen. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iqseḥ deg uɛaqeb.
8:26: Mmektit ed mi, kunwi, drus ay tellam, d uṛhifen di tmurt, teţţagwadem a kwen xeḍfen medden. Iṣṣeṛ ikwen, Isellek ikwen s lɣelb iS, Iɣat ikwen s wayen ilhan, amender ma a ţţesnemmrem.
8:27: A wid iumnen! Ur ţxeyyinet Ṛebbi akked Umazan, ur ţxeyyinet lamanat nnwen, kunwi teẓṛam.
8:28: Cfut ar, ayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d ahewwel kan, u ar ɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ṛṛaṭeb ameqwṛaḥan.
8:29: A wid iumnen! Ma tḥezzbem i Ṛebbi, ad awen Ifk afraz, ad awen Imḥu tucmitin nnwen, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
8:30: Ma ţţandin ak, wid ijehlen, iwakken a k ḥebsen, neɣ a k nɣen, neɣ a k ssuffɣen; ţţandin u Ṛebbi Iţţandi. Ṛebbi Yif akw imendayen.
8:31: Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen nneɣ, ad inin: "ih, nesla. Ma ihwa yaɣ a d nini am ayagi. Ayagi, s tideţ, siwa d timucuha imezwura".
8:32: Mi nnan: "a Ṛebbi, ma illa wagi d tideţ sɣuṛeK, Sseɣli d, fellaɣ, idɣaɣen seg igenni, neɣ Awi aɣ d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
8:33: Ur illi Ṛebbi d win ara ten Iɛaqben, skud telliḍ garasen. Ur Illi Ṛebbi d win ara Iţɛaqben ma nitni la suturen ssmaḥ.
8:34: Acimi ur ten Iţɛaqab ara Ṛebbi, u nitni swexxiṛen si Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, ur llin d imawlan is. Imawlan is, d wid kan iţḥezziben. Maca, tegwti segsen ur ẓṛin.
8:35: Taẓallit nnsen deg Uxxam, siwa aseffeṛ akked llir. Jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb, ɣef wayen tjehhlem.
8:36: Ih, wid ijehlen ţṣeṛṛifen ayla nnsen, iwakken ad ḍeṛṛfen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. A t ṣeṛṛfen, ad asen iuɣal d lexsaṛa. Sinna, ad ţţuɣelben. Wid ijehlen ad ţwafessren di Loahennama.
8:37: Iwakken ad Ifrez Ṛebbi dduni d lɛali, ad Irr ixabiten, wa ɣef wa, a ten Izdi akw, a ten Irr ar Loahennama. Widak d imexsuṛen.
8:38: Ini i wid ijehlen: "ma fukken, ad awen Isemmeḥ ayen iɛaddan; ma uɣalen, ihi, akken teḍṛa d imezwura".
8:39: Nnaɣet ţen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iuɣal ddin s lekmal is, i Ṛebbi. Ma ḥebsen, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţwali ay xeddmen.
8:40: Ma wexxṛen, cfut ar Ṛebbi d Bab nnwen, Bab amxalef, Asellak amxalef.
